nodes.label: Site Improvements Programme (v2)
nodes.rationale: A follow-up audit after the March SEO/conversion overhaul found one schema gap (christmas.html missing AggregateRating, added after the propagation commit) and one limitation (placeholder OG image). The reviewer's v2 revision deliberately dropped aesthetically risky speculative tasks (dark mode, share buttons, micro-interactions) to protect the funeral-service brand's reverent, still aesthetic, and reduced a 5-page hymn-page batch to 2 to protect content quality.

edges.source_location: Context: "comprehensive March 2026 SEO/conversion overhaul (`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-03-28-seo-and-conversion-improvements.md` — fully implemented)"
Task 7 creates abide-with-me.html and jerusalem.html, both of which later appear as guide cards in the music-guides redesign's card grid
